name: cc-super-guarantee
description: Selected Cocos (Keeling) Islands employer superannuation guarantee rules for 2026-27. Covers territorial application, employee and labour-contractor status, qualifying earnings and exclusions, annual employer ceiling, salary sacrifice, fund choice, employer readiness, SuperStream, STP transition/corrections, contribution receipt, conditional deadlines and the Payday Super changeover. Use for island employer super, low earnings, annual-base crossings, new funds, out-of-cycle payments or late-contribution questions. Includes primary legislation, ATO guidance, fictional component calculations, remittance patterns and reviewer controls. This source-cited draft preserves both workflow bases and identifies missing programmes and operational requirements; it does not complete a payroll run, social-contribution engagement or country pack.
